description: This file defines the ActivationCountBasedPlacement class, a placement strategy used in Orleans for load balancing based on activation counts. It includes metadata, documentation, and a singleton instance.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy that balances load based on the number of recently-active grains on each server.

methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the ActivationCountBasedPlacement class.
